# Case Study: South Manubankul

<!-- STEP id="meet-south-manubankul" -->
## A Women-Friendly Panchayat

South Manubankul Gram Panchayat is in Rupaichari Block, under the Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council. It promotes women's participation in decision-making, and the Ministry of Panchayati Raj has recognised it as a **"women-friendly panchayat"** at the national level.

<!-- STEP id="what-it-does" -->
## What the Panchayat Does

It provides facilities for health, sanitation and livelihoods, supports self-help groups, and sees that government schemes are carried out well.

**Cases like these show that democracy is not limited to voting during elections.**
